## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/functionpass">FunctionPass</a> class - This class is used to implement most global optimizations.</p>


<p>Optimizations should subclass this class if they meet the following constraints:</p>


<ol class="doxyList" type="1">
<li>Optimizations are organized globally, i.e., a function at a time</li>
<li>Optimizing a function does not cause the addition or removal of any functions in the module</li>
</ol>
